scenario: On one operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample, verify normal-image WPA2-PSK and strict-SAE completion, IPv4/DNS configuration, gateway reachability, connected-scan continuity, a requested ROAM reaching a new authorized association, and configured NOR multiuser network startup.
expected: Both handshakes complete; network configuration and basic reachability remain available in bounded checks, including after the normal NOR boot path; connected scans preserve service; a requested ROAM reaches a new authorized WPA_COMPLETED association.
observed: Earlier bounded checks on this V1.2 sample reached WPA_COMPLETED with strict SAE and WPA2-PSK; DHCPv4, DNS, and gateway ICMP passed in bounded checks. A prior ordinary NOR boot with an earlier root confirmed automatic WPA3/DHCP startup and basic network access. The 65,536-byte TCP roundtrip with matching host SHA-256 and earlier bounded mDNS no-response checks were on root d38bb7a2. With the previous NOR FIT (397cd8df) and root 9c55, an earlier ROAM returned OK, but authorization completion was not observed before the connection ended ahead of WPA_COMPLETED; this is prior-FIT history, not the current FIT result. On 2026-11-14, current FIT kernel #27 (OS commit 2300977a; SHA-256 recorded in inputs) and the unchanged 10 MiB 9c55 root were written together with built-in verification for both; SPL was preserved. Normal POWER boot reached root on flash1. The 120-second probe returned SKIP no_fresh_compatible_candidate before issuing ROAM. Its 15-row scan showed two same-ESS/SAE alternatives and one eligible alternate, but the candidate file and BSS detail were absent, so the exact prior selection predicate cannot be reconstructed. Runtime symptoms scan error 0x3006 and SAE_ESTale70 were not observed in this run. SAE callbacks in generation 8 completed, followed by reason 4 before EAPOL. Generation 12 later reached SAE/EAPOL and port-authorized; final saved status was COMPLETED with SAE and IPv4, and one host ping reply was received. The connected-scan legacy-disconnect boundary remains; no ordinary ROAM acceptance was tested. One host mDNS lookup timed out. The complete captured diagnostic dump showed no host A record on espwifi0, TX/RX counters 0/0, Up=1 and Down=0; the stock mDNS service was restored successfully. WIFI_PROBE_DONE was received; the capture contained 63,773 bytes and the reader closed two seconds after completion. These results do not establish full Wi-Fi or ROAM acceptance.

limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample; this does not establish support for other revisions.
SAE remained COMPLETED for about five minutes during an earlier bounded session; this does not establish long-duration reliability.
A 65,536-byte TCP transfer and return passed with matching host SHA-256 on the earlier d38bb7a2 root; throughput and sustained reliability were not measured.
802.11k/v/r and BTM/RRM behavior are under investigation and were not validated here.
No forged-frame protection test has been completed.
STATUS pmf=1 means AP MFPC set/MFPR clear; local ieee80211w=2 is the independent required-PMF policy.
The SAE AP observer had no capture delta; SAE completion and IGTK installation rely on supplicant/driver reports, not independent AP-side capture.
The earlier 9c55 ROAM reconnect failure occurred with the previous FIT and is retained as historical evidence. It is not the current kernel #27 result.

The current 120-second probe skipped before ROAM because it could not produce a candidate file. The scan had two same-ESS/SAE alternatives and one eligible alternate, but missing candidate/BSS detail prevents reconstruction of the exact selection predicate. ROAM was not sent.

Current scan0x3006 and SAE_ESTale70 symptoms were not observed in this single run; this does not establish general connected-scan support. Connected-scan legacy disconnect remains a boundary, and the current CAPSCAN implementation work is unpublished.

The current run reached saved COMPLETED SAE/IPv4 status and returned one host ping reply; this does not validate ROAM. A host mDNS query timed out and the complete diagnostic dump showed no host A record on espwifi0 with TX/RX counters 0/0, Up=1, Down=0. Stock mDNS was restored successfully.
WIFI_PROBE_DONE was captured for this bounded probe. The skipped ROAM and unresolved connected-scan and mDNS boundaries mean this is not full Wi-Fi or roaming acceptance.
